supervision: Four structural quality grades using added blur and occlusion; pixelation reserved for evaluation.

training.updated_parameters: Decision readout; visual encoder features cached

partitioning: Actor and identity partitions disjoint across adaptation, calibration, and test.
metric: Accuracy = 100 times the fraction of examples whose maximum logit has the target grade. Positive temperature scaling preserves the maximum-logit class.
standard_deviation: Sample standard deviation across three seeds; frozen readout has one deterministic result.
